verdict.rationale: vLLM is an open-source inference engine that users install and run themselves (pip/uv install, build from source) with full hardware/model support documented, and community posts confirm real-world self-hosted usage (e.g., ScalarLM building on vLLM). missing for 10: no independent third-party deployment guide or benchmark of self-hosting at scale, and no explicit discussion of licensing/self-host operational concerns.
